text: It says the left path is safe.
speaker: Zik

text: For a moment he thought she might argue, might reach for the journal again, might demand he open it and prove the accusation one way or the other.
speaker: Narrator

text: Then she simply looked away, and something in her posture folded inward, the way paper folds when it has finally given up resisting the crease.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik turned toward the left-hand passage.
speaker: Narrator

text: Behind him Ninsun remained standing for a long moment before her footsteps finally started again—quieter now, more careful, as though she had learned something about the ground beneath her that she had not known before.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik reached the mouth of the left-hand passage and stopped because some remaining part of him expected Ninsun beside him.
speaker: Narrator

text: A heartbeat later he could not remember why he had stopped.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun was still there, a dozen paces behind him, her arms wrapped around herself against a cold that had nothing to do with temperature.
speaker: Narrator
